description: This file contains functional tests for RFC (Remote Function Call) management and configuration set hash time validation. It includes test functions that verify the communication between RFC manager and XCONF, and ensure proper handling of config set hash and time values, using assertions and log checks.

methods.name: test_Set_ConfigSetTime_value()
methods.description: Tests setting the ConfigSetTime value via shell command and verifies success message.

methods.name: None test_rfcMgr_xconf_communication()

methods.name: None test_rfcMgr_xconf_communication_configSetHash_Time()
methods.description: Checks the logs for proper population of ConfigSetHash and ConfigSetTime related messages after RFC binary execution.
